You see a gold coin.
It weighs 0.01 oz.

Notes

For more information, read Currency and List of Creatures That Drop Gold Coins. Often abbreviated to "GP" when talking in game. One can be obtained from breaking a Piggy Bank and from Shiny Stones.

Some quests reward Gold Coins:

  • 350 can be obtained from the Dawnport Quest and The Rookie Guard Quest
  • 250 from The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest
  • 201 from the Mastermind Potion Quest
  • 175 from the Berserker Treasure Quest
  • 103 from the Steel Helmet Quest
  • 100 from the Elvenbane Quest, the Formorgar Mine Quest, the Giant Smithhammer Quest, the Skull of Ratha Quest, and the Steal From Thieves Quest
  • 89 from the Skeleton Decoration Quest
  • 82 from the Waterskin of Mead Quest
  • 76 from the Longsword Quest
  • 50 from the Goblin Temple Quest
  • The Explorer Society Quest, and the Uneasy Alliance Quest
  • 40 from the Bear Room Quest
  • 33 from the Alawar's Vault Quest
  • 6 of them can be obtained from Belongings of a Deceased
  • 5 from the Kissing a Pig Quest
  • 3 from the Flash Client Tutorial

History

  • A long time ago gold did not drop in divided piles. For this reason, creatures like Dragon Lords could occasionally get gold stacks of more than 100 (a stack of 150 has been seen at the Tibianic Exhibition).
    • You could not create these piles yourself and very few of them remain today.
    • Some of these piles have been lost due to the first days when the Boats were implemented, due to the people travelling by ship and paying the fee with their gold stacks.
    • Those amounts of Gold Coins above 100 in one pile were lootable in the first weeks of Dragon Lords' existence. Those dragons were first creatures which dropped more than 100 gold.
    • CipSoft changed the 100+ gold stacks in 2-3 stacks with under 100 gold. People lucky enough who obtained overnumbered packs of gold have them nowadays.
    • In the past, these gold stacks were also obtainable daily from Edron Dragon Lair in a chest.
  • On October 21, 2025, the weight was changed from 0.10 oz to 0.01 oz.
